headline: Revenue and earnings per share both accelerate
summary_short: Revenue was ¥404.7B, up 18.5% q/q and 21.5% y/y, and EPS was ¥87.20, up 23.3% q/q and 29.0% y/y.
summary_long: Revenue of ¥404.7B compares with ¥341.6B last quarter and ¥333.2B a year ago. EPS of ¥87.20 compares with ¥70.69 and ¥67.58. These are the only verified figures on file; no results release for the quarter was found, so profit drivers and guidance are not assessed.
confidence_notes: primary filing unreachable — KPI-only summary from verified shard data. KPI-only summary — no filing was read; drivers and guidance not assessed. Revenue is from Yahoo's fundamentals series and may differ from Chugai's core revenue basis; a web search found no Q3 2026 release.
